reason_codes.MEANING_TAUGHT: the sūtra teaches the meaning; PIS 122 is cited only as why the sūtra is needed
reason_codes.SUPPORTING_ARGUMENT: cited to support another point, not to read this sūtra

conditions.text: C1 — PIS 122: a suffix for which no meaning is taught is in its own sense, i.e. the sense of its base.
C2 — The Bhāṣya states it under 3.2.4 etc.; its standard examples are गुप्तिज्किद्भ्यः सन् (3.1.5) and यावादिभ्यः कन् (5.4.29).

quotes.quote: तद्यथा गुप्तिज्किद्भ्यः सन् यावादिभ्यः कन् इति।

conditions.text: C3 — Where a sūtra teaches a meaning (कारके, कर्तरि, बहुषु), the paribhāṣā is the reason that sūtra is needed — it does not apply to that suffix.
